in_sanskrit.name: Harshini
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: From the Sanskrit root 'harsh', meaning to be moved, to feel, to feel joy, or to be touched emotionally, comes Harshini. This name evokes a sense of tenderness, delicacy, and refinement. It is often used for a baby girl who is believed to bring softness and beauty into the world.
